# Brainstorming (sdlc-lean)

Refine rough ideas into an approved design. No code until the design is approved.

1. Classify: spike / bounded / architectural.
2. Ask questions in batches: actual user need, alternatives (incl. deletion), scope boundaries, constraints.
3. Design artifact: Goal, Non-goals, Alternatives (≥2), Trade-offs, Trace (requirement→design→test), Review findings, Leading indicators.
4. Hard gate: no code/plans/tests until human approves the design.
